additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
the charger qbAXSF shows the error fl
ag "PT1000_BT4_Chimney" multiple times in the last 24 hours.

Kind regards,
Marius Schneider

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0376266-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001601] ErrorFlag EVSE TempUpperLImit CRM:00579001053
additional_info.body:
Hello Marius,
Greetings of the day!
There was some miscommunication in the previous mail and apologies for the same.
We also observed error flag
PT1000_BT4_Chimney which was toggling continuously. The request
for ambient temperature was just to corelate it with our findings.
We suspect that these error flags are raised because of one or more of the following issues:
Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust.
The temperature is hot and is making the temperature raise a lot inside the charger. (But here as you mentioned the ambient temperature
is between 12° (night) and 29° (day), hence here temperature might not be the issue)
Sensors not measuring/working correctly.
Issue with Fan rotation.
Therefore, we need to inspect a few things onsite. We will coordinate with our service team for this.
They will update you as soon as there is any progress.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
Thank you
Best Regards

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0376266-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001601] ErrorFlag EVSE TempUpperLImit CRM:00579001053
additional_info.body:
Hello Sascha,
Greetings of the day!
With reference to trailing mail, we need to check the following things onsite-
Check if filters are clear.
Filters of the charger might be clogged or have a lot of dust.
Check if the Fan is rotating properly?
Check whether Sensors measuring/working correctly or not.
Also need to check the electrical connections of FAN and sensors. Refer the KA below for checking further connections:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled - Dynamics 365
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_BT5_MainFanGQ1_XD9.2B - Dynamics 365
Check the connections - terminal blocks, connectors and loose wirings as per the diagram below. Because sometimes faulty connectors or loose connections also causes the issue.
Kindly check BT4, resistance values should be according to the temperature values. You can refer the chart below for the same:
If BT4 found to be healthy then only we need to check for KF6 module as per the diagram above.
But according to our observations, we suspect BT4 to be faulty. Because,
Following we observed in the logs:
Here we can see the drastic change in the values of BT4 in a single minute. The values are increasing and decreasing suddenly within approx. 1 minute. Also sometimes we can see the Invalid values as highlighted.
Hence, need to check the same onsite.
Kindly carry spare BT4 sensor while being onsite.
If found faulty, need to replace it.
Regarding the error-
From the logs we observed that, the Outlet 2 went Out of Order on 26/08/2024 after 14:15:38 UTC.
Refer the logs below:
Mon, 26 Aug 2024 14:08:10 GMT    2024-08-26, 14:08:09    2024-08-26T14:08:09.906166+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [DCC] DC2: StatusCode "READY" --> "NOT_READY"
Mon, 26 Aug 2024 14:08:10 GMT    2024-08-26, 14:08:09    2024-08-26T14:08:09.926400+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [ONR]
DC2 : Outlet not ready - EVSE has overheat shutdown active
Mon, 26 Aug 2024 14:08:10 GMT    2024-08-26, 14:08:10    2024-08-26T14:08:10.081531+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/affceb77e446[707]: PLC-Error-Flag 'Outlet_DC2_codes' changed to true - (DC2 Outlet not ready - EVSE has overheat shutdown active)
And after 14:32:14 UTC, there was
Error polling coap://10.20.17.100:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s
i.e. there was loss in communication to SECC.
Till date, we are getting the same error polling coap for Outlet 2. Hence, need to check the connections to KF11 and KF13 as per the diagram below:
Kindly check the KF11 itself, whether it is getting proper supply of 24V.
Please share your observations once the above mentioned items have been checked.
We will wait for your feedback.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
